title: feat(spec, plugin-security): a controlled_by_parent detail can let read access on its master suffice for insert, update and delete (writeRequiresMasterRead)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XXTFM7hdvH4p6bakQJhPvEg)_

Fixes #33250

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `ObjectSchema` accepts one new optional boolean, `sharing.controlledByParent.writeRequiresMasterRead`; two parse refusals ship with it (the key off a `controlled_by_parent` detail; the key beside `ownerMayEdit: true`), both on declarations that did not parse before. An object that does not declare the key answers byte-for-byte as on `main`.
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/** (the controlled_by_parent authoring guidance)

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：新增按对象开关 `sharing.controlledByParent.writeRequiresMasterRead`。打开后，`controlled_by_parent` 子对象的新增、修改、删除只问"能否读主记录"，之后由子对象自己的对象权限、行级安全和字段级安全决定；不声明的对象行为不变。
- **为什么改**：Leehom 2026-11-14 裁定 A+：「开关打开后,能读主记录的人按子对象自己的授权新增、修改、删除,默认不变。HotCRM 的设计授权全部兑现。」
- **风险与回滚**：只放宽声明了开关的对象；未声明对象零差异（全量 plugin-security 6641 绿）。回滚即 revert 本 PR；已声明该键的元数据届时会在解析时被拒为未知键。
- **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts` 的链式循环（`hopRel.writeRequiresMasterRead` 分支与 `assertMasterRowReadable`），再看 `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` 的两条解析拒绝。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/controlled-by-parent-owner-may-edit.test.ts`（43 绿；去掉读分支后 21 红）。
- **需要你做的**：无。ADR-0055 修订与 `skills/**` 指南由席位另立卡。

## What changes

**`@objectstack/spec`**

- New key `sharing.controlledByParent.writeRequiresMasterRead: z.boolean().optional()` (strict sub-object, beside `ownerMayEdit`), exported reader `controlledByParentWriteRequiresMasterRead(schema)` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, object-form toggle "Read on master is enough to write", liveness ledger child `live`.
- Parse refusals: `true` under any `sharingModel` but `controlled_by_parent` is refused at `sharing.controlledByParent.writeRequiresMasterRead`; `true` beside `ownerMayEdit: true` is refused at `sharing.controlledByParent.ownerMayEdit` with the fix "Delete ownerMayEdit; writeRequiresMasterRead already admits the owner."
- `ISecurityService.checkControlledByParentWrite`, `ControlledByParentWriteOutcome`, `ControlledByParentWriteDenialLeg`: prose only. No type or union changes: a refusal of the read question reuses `object_permission` (master object not readable) and `row_level_security` (master row hidden).

**`@objectstack/plugin-security`**

- The §3 chain walk asks, per hop, READ on the master when that hop's detail opted in, and ends the walk there; a hop that did not opt in asks EDIT as before (so a non-opted detail under an opted master asks edit on its master, then read above).
- That covers insert (single and batch), by-id update and delete, predicate update and delete, re-point (new master and the one it leaves) and emptying an optional master.
- On-behalf-of (ADR-0090 D10): the gate runs once per context, so the agent and the delegator must each read the master. Measured: either one unable to read it refuses the write; both able admits it.
- `checkControlledByParentWrite` and `os explain` (`explain-engine.ts`, `chainAsksMasterRead`) give the same answer as the gate, naming the read question.

**`@objectstack/lint`**: `security-controlled-by-parent-owner-policy-without-opt-in` stays silent on a detail that declares the new key (its own policies decide there). No new rule.

**i18n, docs**: the toggle's label and help text authored in all ten shipped locales (`platform-objects` generated bundles, source hashes dropped) and the Studio zh-CN label; generated references; hand-written pages `permissions-matrix`, `sharing-rules`, `rls`, `error-handling`, `error-catalog`.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/controlled-by-parent-owner-may-edit.test.ts`: `[#33250]` describes on a rig with an opted-in detail, a two-level chain (opted-in under opted-in; not-opted-in under opted-in), RLS on the detail, delegation, and an undeclared CONTROL. 43/43 green. Red on `main`: 21 failed / 22 passed (the delete by a master reader answered `403 requires edit access to its master record (no edit permission on master 'omd_contract')`).
- `explain-controlled-by-parent-write.test.ts`: 4 new pins (87 green).
- `packages/spec/src/data/controlled-by-parent-owner-may-edit.test.ts`: key, reader, both refusals (26 green).
- `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture-owner-may-edit.test.ts`: 4 new pins (40 green).
- Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation proved on disk, restored to HEAD blob):
  - gate read branch off → 21 red (every admit, the read-refusal shapes, delegation and both `checkControlledByParentWrite` pins);
  - `chainAsksMasterRead` → `false` → 3 explain pins red;
  - lint stand-down deleted → 2 red;
  - off-detail refusal off → 4 red;
  - pair refusal off → 1 red.

## Acceptance notes

- **By-id update/delete by someone who cannot read the master answers `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, not 403.** The detail row's own read derives from its master, so the read door hides the row before the write gate runs. That is the platform's hidden-row rule (#7505), unchanged here. Insert and re-point answer `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` ("requires read access to its master record"). `checkControlledByParentWrite` answers `deny` on the legs above for all of them.
- **Predicate (multi-row) update/delete keep the platform ownership floor** (`created_by == current_user.id`) exactly as on `main`; only by-id writes hand that floor to the master gate. The predicate pins seed rows created by another user to prove the opt-in admits them.
- Not in this PR: the ADR-0055 amendment text (`docs/adr/**`) and `skills/**` guidance, carried by the seat.

## Verification

On head `b012326f`:

- Full suites: `@objectstack/spec` 840 files / 26844 tests green; `@objectstack/plugin-security` 267 / 6641 green (45 skipped, as on main); `@objectstack/lint` 208 / 8890 green; `@objectstack/platform-objects` 122 / 1957 green; app-shell `metadata-form-i18n.test.ts` 22 green.
- Typecheck: spec (incl. `check:test-typecheck`, heap 8192), plugin-security, lint, platform-objects exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 123 derived, 122 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, needs every package's dist; CI runs it). Three gates re-run after their prerequisite: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (fetched its pinned fixture commit), `check:skill-examples` (built client-react), `spec check:generated` (test-typecheck at heap 8192).
- `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs` exit 0 (10 packages in sync).
